scope: All 42 manufacturing processes in the Processes tab: 173 source steps plus 2 capability-only planning stages. Material-family route narratives are excluded. Account-specific saved requests are reviewed on load and retained if unclassified.

proposals.name: Liquid handling and pipetting systems
proposals.scope: Manual/electronic pipettes and dispensers, plus automated pipetting workstations; complements pumps M07 and general robots M62.
proposals.caveat: Candidate for transfers and feed preparation; no pipette model is asserted by the source rows.

proposals.name: Magnetic particle separation systems
proposals.scope: Magnetic racks, separators and flow-through magnetic recovery assemblies.
proposals.caveat: P33 step 4 is an optional characterization-preparation branch, not a universal production requirement. Representative magnetic-bead racks are not validated for the cited magnetite formulation.

proposals.name: Quench tanks and immersion cooling vessels
proposals.scope: Water/oil/polymer quench baths and tanks, kept distinct from furnaces and recirculating chillers.
proposals.caveat: P35 explicitly records a water-quench vessel but no make/model; the cited manufacturer page establishes the equipment type only.

proposals.name: Wet-process benches and batch solvent-exchange stations
proposals.scope: Development, rinsing, lift-off, washing and batch solvent-exchange stations, with operation-specific configuration.
proposals.caveat: A planning grouping; a wafer solvent bench does not automatically fit colloidal washing or gel solvent exchange. Separate subtypes and chemistry compatibility are required.

proposals.name: Process data acquisition and feedback-control systems
proposals.scope: Sensor interfaces, DAQ hardware and controllers; software and feedback policies remain configuration data.
proposals.caveat: Existing optical instruments remain M35/M40 and pumps remain M07; DAQ type evidence does not establish a valid closed-loop controller for either cited process.

proposals.name: Casting/moulding fixtures and ambient drying stations
proposals.scope: Scaffold moulds, casting fixtures and controlled ambient conditioning enclosures.
proposals.caveat: Casting fixtures and ambient enclosures are distinct subtypes. Mould geometry/material compatibility requires review. No heated oven is substituted for room-temperature drying.

proposals.name: Powder dispensing and die-loading systems
proposals.scope: Metered powder feeders/dispensers and configurable die-filling/loading assemblies.
proposals.caveat: Candidate for a future automated P41 loading branch. Commercial powder dosing establishes the equipment type, not graphite-die or nanocarbon compatibility.
